name: Two-scale Lorenz '96 model simulation data
model_or_instrument: Lorenz '96 two-scale model (K=8, J=32, F=15, h=1, b=10, c=10)
resolution: dt = 0.005 for true integration, subsampled at Delta t = 0.01; integrated from t = 0 to 100 MTU (500 ATM days)

scales.note: Lorenz '96 model where 1 MTU is defined as 5 atmospheric days (432,000 s); simulation ran for 100 MTU with solver dt=0.005 MTU and training sampling dt=0.01 MTU.
